tools.name: verify_work
tools.description: Verify an AI agent artifact in four layers: schema, emptiness, provenance and mandate authority. Returns an attest verdict.

tools.name: check_skill
tools.description: Privately vet a SKILL.md: structure, triggers, leaked secrets, prompt-injection markers and broken links. Returns a verdict, a score and a sha256 ready to be signed.

tools.name: quote_cost
tools.description: Compute the price from measured usage — tokens, CPU seconds, bytes, storage writes and external calls — instead of a flat price table.

tools.name: trust_report
tools.description: One verdict for an AI agent artifact: work verification (attest) + price from measured usage (agentpay) + mandate availability (drift).

tools.name: suite_status
tools.description: Live status of the Suite layers: attest, agentpay, drift, skilllint.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_skill" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_work" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
